items.headline: Nebraska selling Memorial Stadium urinal troughs ahead of renovation
items.description: The University of Nebraska is selling off soon-to-be removed items from Memorial Stadium ahead of a $600 million renovation, including seats, signs, suite items -- and urinals.

items.headline: College football's backup quarterback talent drain
items.description: How hard is it to get, hold on to and pay a backup QB in today's college football?

items.headline: Big Ten won't punish Maryland-Nebraska game officials or fine Rhule
items.description: No disciplinary action will be taken against game officials who worked last Saturday's Maryland-Nebraska game or against Cornhuskers coach Matt Rhule for his postgame criticism of the crew.

items.headline: Refs incorrectly officiated Nebraska's final PAT attempt, Big Ten says
items.description: The Big Ten acknowledged an officiating error in Saturday's Maryland-Nebraska game that should have resulted in the Huskers retrying a point-after-touchdown attempt.
